title: Fix browser review findings (5 UI bugs)
description:
5 issues from 2026-05-27 audit:
1. Headless browser can't click sidebar items — CSS visibility issue
2. Onscreen agent avatar blocked by empty canvas overlay (z-index)
3. Login form submission doesn't complete (SCRAM flow — may be headless-specific)
4. Missing L2 user config files for fresh users (likely expected behavior)
5. Demo spaces don't navigate visibly

All need headless browser testing environment (Playwright + Chromium). Set up test harness, reproduce, and fix.
notes:
browser_address_bar_test now skips when Electron unavailable. Still needs Electron env to reproduce actual bugs.
Investigated CSS structure:
- router-overlay-layer z-index: 20 (contains onscreen agent)
- onscreen-menu z-index: 30 (above agent — intentional)
- onscreen-agent-root z-index: 2147482000 (scoped within parent stacking context)
- is-edge-hidden class hides agent panel (needs investigation)
- No obvious visibility:hidden issues in menu CSS

Issues need browser to reproduce. Playwright available (1.60.0) but Chromium not installed. Recommend installing Playwright Chromium and writing targeted tests for each bug.
Blocked on: need Playwright Chromium installed to reproduce and test browser UI bugs
Playwright Chromium installed. Tested login flow: form submits but stays on 'Signing in...' — SCRAM challenge API returns 'Invalid username or password' even with correct credentials. CSS analysis: pointer-events:none on parent containers with pointer-events:auto on children (correct pattern). z-index stacking: router-overlay-layer(20) < onscreen-menu(30). Need to debug SCRAM auth flow next.
